title: Text generation production wiring restored
summary:
A quiet infrastructure day: steadier text generation, cleaner Myceli routing, and fresh app-garden metrics.

The production gen service received its restored edge traffic controls and was merged into production, keeping text generation stable when traffic gets enthusiastic.

Cloudflare Worker configurations now explicitly carry both pollinations.ai and myceli.ai custom domains across gen, enter, media, websim, and the main site, making routing consistent across production and staging.

The daily automated update refreshed app health, usage, and greenhouse status so the community directory reflects the current state of the garden.
